comments.author: @EduardoAraujo-uk3dg
comments.text:
I've been there.

- The Amazon forest is so big and dense that animals do not need to enter human territory. I never saw a snake in the road there for example. So little to no risk of wild animal attack.
- The border is open as in Schengen area. No control.
- Flight from Tabatinga to Manaus takes 2h. And we don't leave the Amazonas state. Just to know how massive it is.
- Leticia is more developed than Tabatinga. It has duty-free shops, more tourism infrastructure and restaurants. Tabatinga is mostly residential and also has a Brazilian military base.
- Leticia's city center has loudspeakers with some advertising. Ads in both Portuguese and Spanish are heard, and everybody seems to understand both.
- It's very humid and hot as expected.
- Amazonian food is spectacular. Cuisine of the three countries are present.
- Tours through the Amazon river include visiting Native villages, a planned city called Puerto Nariño and pink dolphin sighting.
- In rainy days Amazon river can be very dangerous. We took a lot of time to cross from one border to another. I though I'd sink.
